Raiton from outside, dehydration, heat and chakra disruption can provoke cramps, lost conductivity or vessel damage; whole body cannot freely become water. Only skin, fascia and selected muscles at once, never bones or brain. Somatic acquired trait not established inheritable.

speed_frame.title: Серебряный шуншин / Нулевой шаг
speed_frame.clean_route: About 25–35 m in ~0.25–0.35 seconds on sound prepared footing and clear trajectory, depending terrain and chakra; one rapid movement, not time-freezing teleportation.
speed_frame.burst_chain: Up to 3–4 hard consecutive starts in an exchange before diminishing foot support, muscular load and neural error risk; several seconds of reduced peak capability afterwards.
speed_frame.combat_limitation: Destination line, inertia, obstruction, reaction windows, enemy sensory prediction and target contact accuracy still matter; speed does not grant simultaneous perception or mastery of all attack styles.
speed_frame.stealth_limitation: Burst movement can make noise, gusts, visible water disturbance or displaced dust; silent stealth movement is a DIFFERENT technique and usually slower.

technique_catalogue.name: Шуншин: Нулевая ступень
technique_catalogue.effect: Extremely fast single burst over traversable physical line, including deceleration into stable stance
technique_catalogue.limits: Not teleport; poor footing/obstacles, sound and muscle strain.

technique_catalogue.name: Шуншин: Три исчезновения
technique_catalogue.effect: Preplanned 2-3 chained bursts changing angle with false visual timing
technique_catalogue.limits: Strong expense; can be predicted via chakra sensory / Sharingan observation.

technique_catalogue.name: Медицинский скальпель: Тихий разрез
technique_catalogue.effect: Subcentimetre controlled contact incision of muscle/tendon/peripheral nerve under movement, capable of nonlethal disablement or fatal injury depending target
technique_catalogue.limits: Requires contact and reach, armor/chakra defences resist; not a distance slash.

technique_catalogue.name: Нейроблокада
technique_catalogue.effect: Temporary targeted local sensorimotor interference via direct touch, with medical feedback
technique_catalogue.limits: Needs precision, stability; not universal paralysis or mind control.

technique_catalogue.name: Суйтон: Безмолвная завеса
technique_catalogue.effect: Low-visibility moisture curtain which masks coordinated movement and alters acoustic cues
technique_catalogue.limits: Wind and powerful sensory counter.

technique_catalogue.name: Суйтон: Водяная тюрьма
technique_catalogue.effect: Confines an accessible target within concentrated water
technique_catalogue.limits: Large water supply, maintenance, countermeasures and immobilization pressure.

technique_catalogue.name: Суйтон: Тысяча игл
technique_catalogue.effect: Precise multi-projectile condensed water senbon in wet surroundings
technique_catalogue.limits: High projectile count reduces individual penetration/accuracy.

technique_catalogue.name: Суйтон: Водяной двойник
technique_catalogue.effect: Short-lived physical water decoy used with reconnaissance and burst angles
technique_catalogue.limits: Limited endurance, can be dispersed.

technique_catalogue.name: Райтон: Живая нить
technique_catalogue.effect: Conduction along prepared senbon/wires or wet channel to disrupt local muscle response
technique_catalogue.limits: Requires channel and careful insulation from own water forms and allies.

technique_catalogue.name: Райтон: Проводимость
technique_catalogue.effect: Short burst of chakra-assisted proprioceptive and muscular recruitment synchronized with Shunshin
technique_catalogue.limits: Costly, risks misfire and transient neuromuscular exhaustion, not reaction omniscience.

technique_catalogue.name: Футон: Сдвиг
technique_catalogue.effect: Short blast to alter projectile path, stabilize ice formation and reposition fog
technique_catalogue.limits: Weaker against high-grade broad wind and fully braced foes.

technique_catalogue.name: Хёотон: Белая гладь
technique_catalogue.effect: Ice surfaces/walls condensed from available water or moisture; can block or deflect projectiles, form footholds
technique_catalogue.limits: Requires chakra+water, vulnerable strong heat/force, no infinite area.

technique_catalogue.name: Хёотон: Стеклянные иглы
technique_catalogue.effect: Multiple hard ice needles with fine trajectory and thermal profile control
technique_catalogue.limits: Ice projectile can fracture, armor/area ninjutsu counters.

technique_catalogue.name: Хёотон: Четыре отражения
technique_catalogue.effect: Own researched 2–4 reflective ice planes form quick Shunshin waypoints and visually confusing angles, partly informed by knowledge Haku had mirror skill; DOES NOT automatically copy Haku's exact Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals
technique_catalogue.limits: Needs setup/near moisture and body momentum, chakra drain, not literal reflective teleport.

technique_catalogue.name: Хёотон: Морозный шов
technique_catalogue.effect: Freezes external water film on surfaces/equipment or briefly fixes exposed fabric/weapons, not instant freezes blood in protected body
technique_catalogue.limits: Needs accessible moisture and temperature, heated/energized counter.

technique_catalogue.name: Нулевой Геном: Текучая ткань
technique_catalogue.effect: Localized reversible partial hydration/softening in selected own tissues; can decrease some shallow cutting damage or escape restrained limb
technique_catalogue.limits: No liquefaction of brain/bones/whole body; vulnerable electricity, dehydration and sudden external force.

technique_catalogue.name: Нулевой Геном: Перепись ткани
technique_catalogue.effect: Slow controlled somatic integration, selection and regulation of compatible donor segments in own tissues
technique_catalogue.limits: Takes months/years, nonzero rejection/tumor/autoimmunity risk; cannot activate unknown doujutsu from eye contact.

technique_catalogue.name: Зеркальная гладь: Нулевая метка
technique_catalogue.effect: Suppresses unusual chakra and basic physiological cues for short infiltration phases; alternate cover physiology
technique_catalogue.limits: Not invisibility, trained sensory experts and chakra interference can detect.

technique_catalogue.name: Гендзюцу: Чужой шаг
technique_catalogue.effect: Briefly distorts enemy sense of limb position and movement timing by direct illusion anchor
technique_catalogue.limits: Strong chakra control, kai, external disruption can break.

technique_catalogue.name: Гендзюцу: Глухая глубина
technique_catalogue.effect: Temporarily misaligns acoustic and vestibular perception to create delayed responses
technique_catalogue.limits: Not absolute deafening; sensory ninja can resist.

technique_catalogue.name: Сенсорика: Пульсовая карта
technique_catalogue.effect: Combines chakra sensing and visible physiological cues to distinguish active signatures, severe distress and nearby chakra suppression
technique_catalogue.limits: No mind reading; barrier/false signature and obstructed medical scans degrade.

technique_catalogue.name: Медицинское ниндзюцу: Тканевая стабилизация
technique_catalogue.effect: Field surgery support, hemostasis, deep tissue repair and neural rehabilitation, within biological limits
technique_catalogue.limits: Does not restore major blood loss instantly, revive dead or unconditionally regrow limbs.
